tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'i cho ga 'brel tshad don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru a mi ta bhā ya/ phyogs dus stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag rgyal kun las// ngo mtshar khyad 'phags smon lam yongs grub pas// mtshan thos tsam gyis 'khor ba dong nas sprugs// dpag med 'od mtshan 'bar la gus phyag 'tshal// de yi sgrub thabs sngon chad ma byung ba// 'phags yul grub pa'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i bcud// 'dir brten bde chen zhing du bgrod 'dod rnams// pad mtshor ngang mo 'jug bzhin don gnyer byos// 'di nyid kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don bar chad med par bde blag tu sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab la yid ches shing byang chub kyi lam las phyir mi ldog par 'dod pa rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba'i tshul la bzhi/ bdag bskyed bsnyen pa/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa/ bum pa'i cho ga nyer mkho'i man ngag zhar byung du bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ lugs 'di'i bka' srol gyi lung nos shing dad mos dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos khrus dang gtsang sbra legs par byas te 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i dkon mchog gi rten bkram pa'i mdun du phyi mchod tsam bsham/ stan bde bar 'khod nas nges 'byung byang chub sems kyi kun slong sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro/ shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥdamar po/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang mgon po 'od dpag med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas tshogs zhing spyan drang*/ na mo gu ru be sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga wān a mi ta bha sa pa ri wā ra pā da ban+d+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag bya/ thugs ka'i sa bon las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par dmigs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mi ta bha sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar spyi ltar sbyar bas mchod/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can gyi// mi dge'i las kun mthol zhing bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// rgyal kun chos 'khor bskor ba dang*// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs mchi zhing*// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyi// dge kun rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsngo// lan gsum/ tshogs rten rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi rgyud la 'dre nges su bsgom/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swā bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar hrīḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar ba'i snang bas rang lus gdos bcas kyi phung po sbyangs te yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma bye bas 'khyud pa lta bu/ tshad med pa'i 'od zer gyi snang bas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas par khyab par mdzad pa/

phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol zhing tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis rab tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la bzhugs pa'o// thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer gyi snang ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas rgyal ba 'od dpag med ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bos rgyas btab par gyur/ thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas su bskor ba la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta pra bhe a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes bzla/ grangs bsnyen ni 'bum phrag bcu ste bye ba gcig go /bzla bya de nyid rtsa bar bzung nas phan yon skyed pa'i yan lag tu gzungs sngags 'di'ang ci nus su bzla ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te a mi ta bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ a mi te/ a mi tod+bha be/ a mi ta saṃ bha be/ a mi ta bi kān+ti ka ri/ a mi ta ga ga na kīrti ka re sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ gzungs 'di'i yon tan ni bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang 'di lan gsum bzlas brjod byas na sgrib pa de rnams zad par 'gyur ro// lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na rtsa ba bzhi'i ltung ba yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas brgya stong la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun par 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas mgon po 'od dpag med nyid kyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel na lhag par byin rlabs che ba yin no// de dag gi skabs su spro bsdu'i dmigs pa spyi mthun sbyor na thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ de rnams dang khyad par nub phyogs bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i mgon po 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan 'ja' 'od zer thig gi rnam par nam mkha' gang ba tsam du byon nas rang la thim pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus thob/ 'od zer slar 'phros/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa/ 'bras bu so so'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa mun khang la nyi zer phog pa ltar sbyangs nas phyi snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can/ nang bcud thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems sha stag tu gyur par bsam pa'ang skabs su bya'o// rtsa bar thun mthar mi dmigs par bzhag nas dge ba bsngo ba tsam las ma bshad pas de ltar gyis 'thus mod/ spyi mthun byas kyang 'gal ba med pas thun 'jog pa na/ tshogs zhing ltar sngags kyis mchod/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ ces gsol ba gdab/ rdor sems yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces mos la bdag nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam la 'jug thun mtshams su yan lag bdun pa sogs dge ba'i las spyi dang*/ khyad par bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo dang bzang spyod smon lam nges par 'don no// //gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub mchod ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung gi mdun du stegs gtsang ma la maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar me tog gi tshom bu dmar po bkod pa bzhag

chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas skor/ 'byor pas lcogs na brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ rin chen bdun sogs 'byor na bsham/ bdag bskyed la gtor 'bul ma bshad kyang 'dir spyi 'gro ltar rin po che'i snod du dkar zlum dkar gsum dang bcas pa dgod/ khrus kyi chas/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal sogs nyer mkho rnams tshogs par bya/ bum chog byed na rnam bum dang las bum dri'i chu dang bya rgyud bum rdzas bco lnga'i bcud ldan/ mgul chings dmar po/ kha rgyan/ dung chos gzungs rdor bcas maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas g.yon du dgod/ skyabs sems nas brtsams bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa gshegs bsdu'i bar btang*/ dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can gyi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po rab tu rgyas pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa/ de'i steng du hrīḥdamar po 'od 'bar ba yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das sogs bdag bskyed skabs ltar la/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i sa bon sogs nas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspos btul/ mos gus bskyed la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur ba'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol// oṃ bha ga wān a mi ta bha sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam/

bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sat+kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra trīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas sku khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// om̐ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ bha ga wān a mi ta bha sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bos rgyas btab par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar zla steng sa bon sngags phreng bcas gsal ba la rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i bag chags sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs/ bde ba can du skye ba'i skal ba can tu byin gyis brlabs par bsam la snying po dang gzungs ring ci nus su bzla/ de nas mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang bdag gi bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang rig sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la mchog tu rgya chen po byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa las mngon par mtho ba'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po rab tu 'phro bar gyur cig

ces dang*/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags lan brgyad bzlas pas mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod// nā mo bha ga wān a mi ta bha sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ sgra snyan/ zhes dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da/ zhes bcug la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ gos zung bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa/ 'jam pa/ yang ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces dang*/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /mtshan sngags sngar ltar la/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+rā ya āḥhūm̐/ btags la 'bul/ rgyal srid bdun ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /mtshan sngags dang*/ tsakra rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi rat+na= btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wa sti rat+na/ blon po rin chen= /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog

/ma hā ta rat+na= glang po rin chen= lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg par rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ha sti rat+na= rta mchog rin chen= srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṃ ga= dmag dpon rin chen= nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍ+ga rat+na= zhes brjod cing dbul/ 'dod yon lnga dbul ba ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// mtshan sngags mthar/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= shab+da= phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= gan+dhe/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= ra sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// spar+she kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ skabs 'dir spro na maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma dang tshigs bcad ji ltar 'os pas phul nas 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ rdor dril dbyangs bcas/ rgyal ba zla ba dri ma med pa'i sku// rgyal ba nyi ma 'od zer stong gi 'od// rgyal ba pad+ma dri ma med pa'i spyan// rgyal ba me tog pad rtsa rdul med tshems// rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu ste// rin po che ni du ma'i 'byung gnas gyur// rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes chu yis gang*// ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong gis kun tu gang*// rgyal ba'i zhabs ni 'khor los bris pa ste// 'khor yug mu khyud de bzhin rtsibs ma stong*// phyag dang zhabs ni drwa bas spras pa ste// zhabs kyi drwa ba ngang pa'i dbang po bzhin// gser gyi ri bo lta bur rab tu gda'// rgyal ba dri med gser gyi ri dbang po// yon tan thams cad ri dbang 'dra ba ste// sangs rgyas ri dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba chu zla 'dra// nam mkha' dang yang mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste// sgyu ma smrig rgyu lta bur chags pa med// rgyal ba dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bde gshegs spyi bstod gser 'od las 'byung ba dang*/

gong smos/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba sogs sh+lo kas bstod/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma'i steng du āḥlas zla dkyil dbus// hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros pas// gtor mar thim pas gtor ma ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ de nyid bcom ldan ljags rtse'i 'od zer gyi// sbu gus drangs te gsol bas mnyes par gyur par bsams te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis phul te/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces 'dod don gsol lo// gsum pa ni/ bum pa sgrub dgos na bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma'i sdong po sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo'i rgyas btab par gyur par brjod/ gzungs thag blangs la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brgyud de song*/ bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs bsdus/ sku dang sngags phreng las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs la snying po dang gzungs sngags ci 'grub bzla/ mthar/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ dung zhal gyi mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par mos/ las bum bsang sbyang*/ las kyi bum pa'i go sa ru// sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// hūm̐ las khro bo rta mgrin ni// dmar zhing nyi ma ltar 'bar ba// spyan gsum mche gtsigs hūm̐ sgra sgrogs// spyi bor rta mgo ljang gus mtshan// phyag bzhi pad dbyug rdo rje dang*// sdigs mdzub pad+ma'i sdong po 'dzin// g.yon brkyangs khro bo'i chas kyi brgyan// me phung 'bar ba'i dbus bzhugs pa'i// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs stod hrīḥ

/'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis med gyur// slar yang dbang lhas dbang bskur te// snang ba mtha' yas dbu brgyan gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rta mgrin rgyal// drag po'i rta skad sgrogs pa yis// gdug pa can rnams 'joms par mdzad// khro bo'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ sngags bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul te sku las bdud rtsi khro chung gi rang bzhin babs pas bum pa gang bar mos nas/ oṃ ha ya grī ba hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ brgya rtsa bzla/ khro bo'i dbang po 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur/ skabs 'dir gzhan la bkru byabs dgos na bya/ de nas rjes kyi rim pa ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la sngar ltar byin brlab/ tshigs bcad bcas chu gnyis nyer spyod 'bul/ bstod pa/ bcom ldan cho ga'i bya ba la// ma tshang ba dang lhag pa dang*// 'gal zhing 'khrul pa ci mchis pa// kun nas bzod par mdzad du gsol// zhes nongs pa gshags shing*/ rten yod na ye shes pa brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ rten med na/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes slar 'byon par gsol ba btab nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pas bgegs dang bar chad las bsrungs par mos/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'od dpag med mgon 'grub gyur sogs brjod/ de nas bzang po spyod pa dang bde chen zhing gi smon lam ci nus gdab/ shis brjod ni/ me tog 'thor la/ bsam gtan ting 'dzin dam pa pha rol phyin pa'i gnas// ye shes pad+ma'i steng bzhugs dpag med tshe ldan zhing*// tshe grangs med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir zhi byed legs gyur cig

/ces dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs brjod par bya'o// bzhi pa nye bar mkho ba'i las phran ni/ 'di'i sgo nas khrus chog byed na/ sbyong gtor/ gul yungs sogs 'du bya/ bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod de/ sbyong gtor la chab bran/ da lam/ 'dir sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bde blag tu zhi ba la ched du bsngags pa bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnal 'byor la brten nas byab khrus kyi cho ga bsgrub pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba gsum du yod pa'i sngon 'gro sbyong ba rnam pa gsum bya ba la/ thog mar zhi ba'i sgo nas log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs la gtor ma byin te sbyong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ theb kyu snod dang bcas pa dbus g.yas g.yon gyis rim par blangs te/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān sogs brjod cing bsgrub bya la g.yas su bskor zhing snod gcig tu bsag gnyis pa zhi drag phyed ma'i sgo nas ting lo dang changs bu sbyin te sbyong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag sngar bzhin blangs te g.yon du bskor zhing*/ sum+bha'i sngags brjod/ gsum pa drag po'i sgo nas sbyong ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa sogs nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar khro bo spyan 'dren mchod bstod bcas sngon du 'gro bas bden pa bdar ba dang mnyam du de rnams kyi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa hūm̐ phaṭa kyi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros shing*/ yungs kar gyi thun rnams kyang khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dpag tu med par gyur te gdon bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas 'gyur ro// bar spyi ltar brjod/

rta mgrin yi ge bcu pa dang sum+bha'i sngags brjod/ yungs kar 'thor/ gu gul bdug rgyas par bden brjod lan gsum bya/ gtor ma phyir dor/ bsdu na khro bo spyan 'dren dor yang chog go /dngos gzhi bkru byab srung gsum las/ dang po bkru ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te khyed rang gi gdong dang yan lag la sogs pa bkrus pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa sgo gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad me long g.ya' phyis pa ltar sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thog mar bum chus kha bshal/ de nas 'thung du gzhug dril gsil dang bcas ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shri ye hūm̐ bar dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs nas shri ye hūm̐/ bum chu spyi bo nas blugs shing*/ snying po dang gzugs sngags kyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba bigh+nan bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru= sarba ro ge bh+yaḥ= sarba duṣ+ṭan bh+yaḥ= sarba gra he bh+yaḥ= sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥ= sarba byā dhi= sarba u pa dra be= sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu= sarba dur swap+ni= sarba dur ni mit+te= sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkru'o// khar bum chu 'dzin du bcug la/ gnyis pa byab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba la hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gsal btab ste/ de nyid slob dpon gyis lag gi rdo rje dang lhan cig tu bzung ste khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bskor zhing byabs pa la brten nas sgo gsum gyi nad gdon nyer 'tshe thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags len pa ltar blangs te rgya mtsho chen por dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ snying po dang gzungs sngags mthar/ rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bh+yaḥ.a pa nā ya swā hā/

sogs nas sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥ.a pa nā ya swā hā zhes kha nang gi chu khrus gzhong du dor ro// tshar grangs gsog dgos na gong gi sngags ring thung nas 'di'i bar bkru ba re dang byab pa re spel zhing grangs gzung ngo*// 'dir sdig sgrib sbyong ba gtsor byed na rnam bum dang*/ nad gdon zhi ba gtsor byed na las bum gyis khrus bya dgos pas phyi ma'i skabs rta mgrin yi ge bcu pa la bkru byab kyi sngags gdags/ dmigs bsal med na snga ma rnam bum dang de rjes las bum gyis gnyis ka byas kyang legs so// gsum pa srung ba'am slar mi 'jug par bya ba'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo dang mdun rgyab gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis/ pus mo gnyis te gnas bdun du rdo rjes reg pas rdo rje las rdo rje de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung ste/ lus la rdo rje'i go bgos nas phyin chad bdud dang bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gnas de dag tu rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag cing*/ sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bh+yaḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ zhes brjod/ rjes bden stobs brjod cing shis par bya ba ni/ slar yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing*/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i nus mthu yis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig /ces dang*/ slob dpon phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang bcas pas bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas/ ston mchog dam pa'am che ba'i che mchog ma gang rung gi mthar/ 'byung po gang dag dang*/ nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod do// bsgrub bya rang gnas su btang la cho ga'i rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o// yang da lta'i gang zag mchog dman kun la gal che ba 'od dpag med nyal 'phor grags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi man ngag dang*/

slob dpon dzai tā ri dang rdo rje gdan pa sogs las brgyud pa'i man ngag dang*/ sa skya pa khu dbon rnams kyi gsung rab las 'byung ba ltar nyams su len pa ste/ 'di la bzhi/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes/ phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thos shing the tshom med pa'i yid ches kyi nges pas drangs te mgon po 'od dpag med dang*/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams la dang ba dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ yid ches pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis bde chen zhing bkod dam/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku bris 'bur gang rung zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ de'i mdun du nyal ba'i skabs mgo nub tu bstan/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu bcug nas gnyid log pa'i stan bde bar bsham/ nyal ba'i snga rol du 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i dkon mchog gsum mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la dmigs nas skyabs 'gro bzhi skor grangs bdun nam gsum sogs ci rigs pa bya'o// sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'od dpag med bsgom par bya snyam du sems bskyed/ gnas khang dang sa phyogs thams cad dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du bsam/ rang yi dam du bsgom par gsungs pas thugs rje chen po yid kyis gang gsal bsgom/ mdun du rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ yang na na bza' chos gos rnam pa gsum gsol ba'i sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ ces gang mos bya/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing snang la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/

bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ 'jug pa bde bar byed na 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i/ na mo bha ga wa te a mi te bh+yaḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ me tog la sogs pas mchod par bsgoms nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags so// bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// sangs rgyas thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo// mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces lan gsum bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes nas byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i tshe rang gi rnam par shes pa 'od dkar po'i rnam pa can sna bug g.yas nas thon/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi shangs bug g.yas su zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim pas rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsam/ dbugs nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer dkar po de mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par shangs bug g.yas nas thon te rang gi sna bug g.yas su zhugs/ snying gar thim pas rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsam/ de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mgal me 'khor ba ltar grangs mi gzung bar ji tsam gnas kyi bar du bya/ gsum pa rjes ni/ thun 'jog khar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la thim/

bla ma rnams sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la thim/ dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang bstun/ snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim/ bdag kyang 'od du zhu nas sangs rgyas yi dam rang sems gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang nas mgon po 'od dpag med sngar bsgoms pa ji lta ba la dmigs pa gtad de/ oṃ a mi ta bha hrīḥswā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ de nas grub na bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang*/ de tsam ma lcogs na/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na// sogs/ sems can rnams la phan pa mang bgyid shog /ces sh+lo ka bzhi po de tshar grangs ci nus brjod/ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas rang la bstims pa'i sangs rgyas bde ba can tu gshegs par bsams la/ rang gi dpral mgrin snying ga rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum bkod pas bsrungs nas yid gzhan du mi 'gyur bar bde ba can du 'pho ba'i 'dun pa dung nge ba'i ngang nas gnyid log go /'di'i skabs su stobs bzhi tshang bas yan lag bdun pa phul bas sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam yang 'dag pa'i nges shes bskyed/ tshe 'di'i lus longs spyod dang*/ nye du 'khor g.yog dang 'chi ba'i dus nges par 'bral bas zhen 'dzin thams cad gtang*/ bdag 'chi ba'i dus bde ba can tu 'gro snyam pa'i gdeng tshad dang*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song la mi 'jigs pa'i bsam pa dang ma bral bar bya/ nyin mo la sogs pa gnas skabs kyi spyod lam thams cad du 'dug pa'i gnas bde ba can gyi zhing khams su bsams la rtag tu sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang mi 'bral bar bsgom/ 'gro ba'i tshe rang gi mdun du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa'i phyogs su 'gro bar bsam/ bzhi pa phan yon ni/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa tshe 'dir nad gdon bar chad med cing tshe ring ba dang*/ 'chi ba'i dus 'od dpag med kyi thugs rjes gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung*/ bar do'i 'jigs pa las bsgral nas/ lus 'di sbrul shun brjes pa ltar nub phyogs bde ba can du pad+ma las brdzus te skyes nas/

snang ba mtha' yas las chos nyan par dkon mchog brtsegs pa las gsungs shing*/ bde can zhing bkod kyi mdo las kyang de ltar bsngags pa dang*/ gzhan yang mdo las/ ngas ni sngon gyi smon lam 'di skad btab// sems can gang gis nga yi ming thos na// nga yi zhing du rtag tu 'ong bar shog /nga yi smon lam bzang po de rdzogs pas// 'jig rten khams mang dag gnas sems can 'ongs// de dag nga yi zhing du lhags nas ni// de dag skye ba gcig las phyir mi ldog /ces mgon po 'od dpag med kyi mtshan thos pa dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed cing zhing der skye ba'i smon lam btab na/ zhing der skyes nas ngan song du phyir ldog pa gtan mi srid par ston pa thugs rje can gyi gsung bslu ba mi srid pa la yid ches shing gus pas nyams su blangs na don chen por 'gyur ba yin no// zhing bkod las tha na sems bskyed du 'gyur ba bcus sems bskyed na zhing khams der skye bar gsungs pa'i sems bskyed du 'gyur ba bcu ni lhag pa'i bsam pa skul ba'i mdo las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi yon tan de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa gang lags pa 'di dag las gang gis sems bskyed pa gang yang rung ba zhig yid la bgyid cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med yid la bgyid pa de sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar 'gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das sems bskyed pa de dag gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// byams pa sems bskyed pa gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi sangs rgyas zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can tu skye bar 'gyur bar byed pa de dag ni byis pa'i sems bskyed pa ma yin/

skyes bu dam pa ma yin pa'i sems bskyed pa ma yin/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sems bskyed pa ma yin te/ byams pa sems bskyed pa bcu po ni 'di dag yin no// bcu gang zhe na/ byams pa 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa la zhe 'gras pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye bar mi nus te/ sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'tshe ba yongs su spangs te sems can thams cad la snying rje'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ lus dang srog la mi lta bar dam pa'i chos srung ba'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ zab mo'i bzod pa las nges par gyur pas dam pa'i chos la mngon par zhen pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ rnyed pa dang bkur stis ma gos pas bsam pa yongs su dag pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ brjed pa med pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rin po cher sems bskyed pa dang*/ zhum pa med pas sems can thams cad la bla ma bzhin du gus pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag nges pas nyi tshe ba'i bsam gtan gyi ro myang bar mi bya ba'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ ma 'dres pas dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ mtshan ma yongs su spangs te sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sgom pa'i sems bskyed pa ste/ byams pa'i sems bskyed pa bcu po ni de dag yin te/ sems bskyed pa bcu po de dag las sems bskyed pa gang yang rung ba'i sems bskyed pa gang yin pa de ni sems bskyed pa de dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar mi 'gyur ba de ni gnas med do// zhes gsungs pa nyid kun mkhyen dol po sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab tu drangs par mdzad pa'i mdo 'di da lta'i mdo sde'i khrod du bzhugs par mi snang ngo*// 'od dpag med mgon smon lam yongs grub cing*// ston mchog shākya'i rgyal po'i bden gsung mthus// 'brel tshad bde can zhing skyes phyir mi ldog

/sa lam myur bgrod byang chub mchog thob shog /'di'ang rje bla ma thams cad gzigs pa chen pos 'bri dgos kyi bka' stsal spyi bor phebs kyang rim lus su gyur pa/ slad nas rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyi dgongs pa skong ba'i ched du ris med pa la dad pa'i lhag bsam 'chang ba karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
